package fixture

import (
	"os"
	"testing"
)

// built holds one built program's bytes, read once and handed to every fixture
// that needs it. This is nova-wake's fakeBins shape: the ReadFile is in one
// function and the executing WriteFile is in another, reached through the map.
var built = map[string][]byte{}

func build(t *testing.T) {
	raw, err := os.ReadFile("tool")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	built["tool"] = raw
}

func install(t *testing.T, dst string) {
	build(t)
	if err := os.WriteFile(dst, built["tool"], 0o755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
